title: GOV-01 static acquisition locator-free public result v2 (draft)
description: Exact stdout contract for read-only census/verify, acquire success, and fail-closed results. Gate and gate-set receipts require the frozen executor semantic checker; this schema never grants execution, cleanup, retry, OpenSpec, commit, or push authority.

artifact_path_uniqueness_policy.const: content-addressed checker rejected every duplicate path independent of role, byte_length or raw_file_sha256; JSON Schema uniqueItems alone is insufficient

content_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01-OFFLINE-CACHE/v1) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 6 TAB-separated columns: lock_key, version, resolved, integrity, compressed_bytes, actual_integrity

ustar_closure_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/USTAR-CLOSURE/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 13 TAB-separated columns: lock_key,version,integrity,compressed_bytes,tar_bytes,member_count,raw_regular_count,raw_directory_count,payload_bytes,strip_root,package_name,package_version,member_manifest_sha256; each member_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/USTAR-PACKAGE-MEMBERS/v2) || NUL || sorted LF-terminated 8-column rows: lock_path,member_index,kind,raw_path,stripped_or_dash,mode04o,size,digest)

resolution_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/NODE-RESOLUTION-CLOSURE/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is lexicographically sorted LF-terminated rows of exactly 7 TAB-separated columns: source_or_<root>,edge_type,dep_name,spec,target_or_dash,target_version_or_dash,state

expected_tree_receipt_profile.const: SHA-256(ASCII(CLS/GOV01/DETERMINISTIC-NODE-MODULES/v2) || NUL || UTF-8 body); body is LF-terminated rows sorted by UTF-8 path bytes with exactly 5 TAB-separated columns: kind,path,mode04o,size,identity where identity is file SHA-256, relative symlink text, or dash for directory

direct_sri_policy.const: each source content-v2 locator derived directly from package-lock sha512 SRI; actual sha512 integrity matched; no cache index lookup

path_policy.const: UTF-8 strict; NFC; relative; slash-separated; no empty/dot/dotdot component; no absolute path; no backslash; no NUL/control; no duplicate or normalization/case-fold collision; openat-style no-follow beneath stage

header_policy.const: verify magic/version/checksum; strict octal; zero padding; two terminal zero blocks; EOF immediately after 1024-byte terminator padding; reject trailing payload

generated_symlink_policy.const: only exact relative link text bound by resolution receipt; resolved target must remain inside final tree

const: create one exact 0700 challenge claim directory as the first authorized write and create/append/fsync its exact 0600 ledger.jsonl; never automatically delete either
create exact previously-absent acquisition target by one successful renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL)
create and fsync one exact same-parent same-filesystem 0700 stage tree with a 0600 incomplete marker
write only the frozen expected directories, regular-file payload bytes and generated relative bin symlinks under that stage
remove only the exact incomplete marker immediately before publication
overwrite, merge into, unlink or rename an existing target
modify existing package.json, package-lock.json or .gitignore; create any absent alternate lock file or .npmrc
modify Git objects, refs, index, hooks, config or worktree content outside the exact new target
write outside exact challenge claim/ledger, exact stage and exact exclusive target; stdout is not a filesystem mutation
write user home, private Vault, Graphiti or network state
commit, push or create a branch/ref

public_gate_receipt_profile.const: CLS/GOV01/STATIC-ACQUISITION-GATES/v2; G00..G24 byte-sort; PASS only; public evidence digests only

next_required_authorization.const: new runtime-use envelope binding this final-tree receipt and a fresh single-use challenge

git_metadata_adapter_trust_boundary.const: the kernel and each owning same-UID production process are trusted; POSIX 0600 and 0700 modes isolate other UIDs but do not isolate an unsandboxed process with the same effective UID, so each adapter root has exactly one owning process and compliant same-UID product processes never mutate another invocation's root; non-cooperating same-UID filesystem mutation, out-of-process ptrace or code injection, and out-of-process access to the 0600 private HMAC key are outside the supported threat model

git_metadata_adapter_host_assurance.const: every spawned Git child is sandboxed and has no authority to create, rename, unlink or write the private-temporary parent namespace or any sibling adapter root; the product owns only the fresh exact adapter entry, root and descendants for that invocation, while /private/tmp and sibling entries remain ambient host namespace; every product invocation creates one fresh unique adapter root; the process-wide non-reentrant scope and registry forbid interleaved adapter ownership within one process and do not claim cross-process exclusion
